articles.title: PM sets up task force headed by UIDAI chief Nandan Nilekani for exam reforms; panel to revamp NTA through technology & structural changes
articles.summary: The Indian government is introducing a Bill in Lok Sabha to amend laws preventing unfair practices in public examinations, exemplified by NEET. This key legislation, coming a day after Prime Minister Modi's expected mention, targets curbing paper leaks and cheating. It aims to ensure greater transparency and fairness, reinforcing academic integrity for aspirants nationwide.

articles.title: Army rescues 790+ people as Gujarat flood relief operations end
articles.summary: The Indian Army successfully concluded extensive flood relief operations in Gujarat, rescuing over 790 individuals from flood-affected areas. This highlights the crucial role of the armed forces in national disaster management and humanitarian aid. Such missions demonstrate the Army's dedication to assisting citizens during natural calamities, reinforcing their multi-faceted capabilities and commitment to national service beyond conventional combat roles.

articles.title: On Kargil Diwas, PM Modi hails INS Mahendragiri, DRDO's Pinaka and Kusha tests, calls for 'vocal for local' in Mann Ki Baat
articles.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi commemorated Kargil Diwas, honoring the unparalleled bravery and sacrifice of Indian soldiers. He underscored the nation's steadfast progress towards achieving 'Atmanirbharta' (self-reliance), particularly in the defence sector. This focus on indigenous capabilities not only bolsters national security but also embodies the resilient spirit of the armed forces, reinforcing India's strategic autonomy.

articles.title: For some, so-called 'Skynet Day' came too close to sci-fi after a rogue agent hacked into a startup
articles.summary: The article introduces James Cameron's earlier warnings, drawing parallels with the contemporary rise of AI, exemplified by OpenAI and platforms like Hugging Face, co-founded by Sam Altman. It suggests a reflection on how fictional cautionary tales about advanced technology might relate to today's rapid AI developments, implying a discussion about the foresight of these predictions amidst current advancements.
